svg.title: Well pressure monitor wiring
svg.desc: A 0–150 psi pressure transducer runs on 5 V from EXT1.1 and feeds ADS1115 input A0 through R1 (10 kΩ). R2 (10 kΩ) and C4ext (100 nF) connect A0 to common ground in parallel. ADS1115 VDD connects to 3.3 V at EXT1.2. ADDR and GND connect to common ground at EXT1.3. SDA is GPIO13 on EXT2.10 and SCL is GPIO16 on EXT2.7. C1ext and C2ext (100 nF each) connect their respective supply rails to common ground.
svg.text: Sensor connector red +5 V · green OUT · black GND
GPIO17 is used for the Ethernet clock.
